state.objective: Determine why browser blocks POST requests from app.domain.com to api.domain.com.

submitted_answer.answer: Credentialed cross-origin requests are rejected because the server combines Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true. The server must return the exact requesting origin (https://app.domain.com), allow credentials, and permit the POST method and headers.
